high_level_description: This image depicts a large, ornate building with a classical architectural style, situated on the side of a road. The building is painted in a light beige color and features multiple arched windows and decorative elements along its facade. At the top, there is a dome-like structure with a small flagpole, suggesting it might be an important or official building. In front of the building, there is a black metal fence with gold-colored finials at the corners. A signboard is prominently displayed near the entrance, which reads "Vivekananda House" in both English and Tamil script.
